messages:
priya: Heads-up: kicking off a compact entitlements sweep next week. goal: remove obvious admin bit abuse and surface stale owners. plan = discovery -> KMS enrichment -> notify -> small prune.

dylan: scope? include cross-account roles and infra projects?

priya: yes to both. we'll exclude known infra pipelines and flagged vendor principals. sample size for canary = 0.5% of admin principals.

emily: for KMS integration i'll pull grants and key policies. script will add `kms_grants` and `kms_policies` columns to the audit CSV. will also add `last_key_use`.

sec-bot: NOTICE: audit-ingest-lag = 3m20s for prod. recommended to be <90s for accurate last_auth.

dylan: hold the prune until lag < 90s. dry-run discovery can go on though.

priya: agreed. dry-run Thu 09:00 PT (no changes), enrichment Fri 09:30 PT, canary Mon 07:00 PT (apply to sample). full run Wed if canary clean.

emily: notifier draft: `owners=$(rbac-audit --stale 45)` then DM with ack link. 24h ack window. lack of ack escalates to team oncall then ops.

dylan: add a safety net: before removing admin, ensure `rbac-check --verify <critical_admins>` passes post-change; if not, auto-rollback and page ops.

ops: please publish rollback steps in runbook: rebind role, re-grant KMS, clear cache. include commands for both AWS and GCP.

priya: will update runbook and attach checklist. also adding CSV export: `principal,kind,bindings,kms_keys,last_auth,evidence_url`.

emily: i'll join grants to IAM and annotate vendor principals so they get manual review.

sec-bot: CVE watch: no high sev infra CVEs open. will post if that changes.

dylan: tagging @emily to drop the CSV to shared drive and ping reviewers once audit-ingest stable. thanks all. retro Wed 11:00 PT. :thumbsup:
